prompts.landmarks: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for Burning Hills, an isometric cozy town-building game. Create a genuinely transparent RGBA PNG, 3 columns by 2 rows, six separate fully visible carefully painted objects, each strictly within its own equal cell with generous transparent gutters, no grid lines. Detailed premium hand-painted 2.5D game illustration, warm afternoon sunlight from upper left, lush moss and vegetation, muted copper sandstone, matching richly textured green garden game art. Camera fixed orthographic isometric, approximately 35 degree downward view. Row 1 left: broad asymmetrical low copper-red sandstone hill with terraced rocky face, grassy rounded summit, scattered small golden maple trees and moss; it is a landscape hill not a pile of boulders. Row 1 middle: different wide rolling grassy hill with warm rusty red rock outcrops, a winding narrow hiking path and small autumn trees. Row 1 right: reclaimed old brick kiln chimney landmark, squat weathered copper brick chimney with climbing ivy, a small stone seating wall, copper pipe and flowers at foot, no active fire and NO smoke included. Row 2 left: charming town entrance sign made of salvaged timber and copper supports with wildflowers and warm little lanterns. Only text on the sign exactly 'BURNING HILLS', readable engraved lettering, no other text anywhere. Row 2 middle: inviting tiny street-cafe grouping with round wooden table, two empty chairs, green and cream parasol, potted flowers and two coffee cups, no people. Row 2 right: two low rustic posts supporting a short gentle arc of cheerful terracotta, teal and cream fabric pennants, flowers by posts, isolated decorative festival bunting. Preserve actual transparent background, no baked checkerboard, no white or colored backdrop, no rectangular ground tile, no text labels, no watermark. All objects grounded with irregular soft grass/earth edges. Keep each object completely separated and unclipped.
prompts.landmarkSpacing: Edit this sprite atlas ONLY to give all six separate objects generous transparent space around them for clean Unity slicing. Keep the exact six subjects, their beautiful painted materials and architecture, the readable 'BURNING HILLS' sign, warm colors, camera angle and transparent alpha. Use a strict 3-column by 2-row grid across the canvas. Scale each whole object down to fit ENTIRELY inside its equal cell with a minimum 35 pixel empty transparent margin on ALL sides. No silhouette or shadow may cross a cell boundary. Each hill must stay inside its own top cell; the chimney inside top right, sign bottom left, cafe bottom middle, pennants bottom right. A clean transparent gutter must divide columns and rows. Do not add any background, glow, haze, scenery, checkerboard, labels or grid lines. Preserve complete objects with no cropping, actual transparent RGBA PNG.
prompts.townLife: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite atlas for a premium cozy isometric garden town named Burning Hills. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard or painted background. EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and 3 ROWS with 12 equally sized cells and generous clear transparent gutters. Every sprite fully inside its own cell, identical foot baseline within each row, no contact shadow, no ground patches. Detailed hand-painted storybook realism matching lush warm green city-building game art, small believable anatomies, three-quarter isometric view from slightly above, soft upper-left afternoon light, muted warm colors, no outlines, no text. All people viewed from front three-quarter and facing right. Row1 cells1 and2: the SAME adult woman in terracotta jacket, cream shirt, green trousers, brown shoes, carrying a small canvas grocery bag, WALK frame A left leg forward then frame B right leg forward, identical face and outfit and scale. Row1 cells3 and4: the SAME adult man in teal jacket, ochre scarf, brown trousers, small flat cap, WALK frame A then frame B, identical outfit and scale. Row2 cells1 and2: the SAME older woman with silver hair, long plum coat and soft green skirt, holding a bunch of flowers, WALK frame A then frame B, identical outfit and scale. Row2 cells3 and4: the SAME young adult wearing tan vest and rolled-up sleeves on a green vintage bicycle, pedal frame A then frame B, both bicycle wheels visible, right-facing three-quarter view, identical proportions. Row3 cells1 and2: the SAME single graceful small swallow in flight viewed from above, wings raised then wings spread down, blue-black back and cream underside, facing right. Row3 cells3 and4: the SAME single copper-orange butterfly seen from above, open wings then raised wings, delicate natural pattern. Each sprite distinct separate isolated with no neighboring overlap. Crisp production sprite edges with actual transparent alpha, no props beyond described, no watermark.
